title: Mark Ruffalo Says Paramount-Warner Bros. Merger Will ‘Stifle Creativity’ and ‘Weaken Free Speech’: It ‘Should Never Have Been Approved’
content:
ByPayton Turkeltaub

Mark Ruffalois speaking out against the Paramount-Warner Bros. Merger once again, this time following the news on Wednesday that the dealhas been approvedand is tentatively set to close next week.

“This merger will stifle creativity, weaken free speech, and cost people their jobs — it is a bad deal for this country and should never have been approved,” wrote Ruffalo in a statement posted toThreadson Wednesday. “This is an incredibly disappointing outcome for the hundreds of thousands of us who stood up to block it, but it’s also not the end. This grassroots movement isn’t going to fade away and neither is our resolve.”

He continued: “This was never about just one merger: this was about fighting back against corrupt oligarch billionaires trampling the interests of everyday people to line their own pockets. We’re still in that fight. Join us.”

Ruffalo has long been outspoken about his opposition to the merger.Earlier this month, Ruffalo encouraged California Attorney GeneralRob Bontaand his coalition of 11 other state AGs not to settle their lawsuit against Paramount Skydance, which would effectively keep David Ellison from acquiringWarner Bros.Discovery.

“Don’t you dare, [Rob Bonta], do not cave,”Ruffalo wrote on X. “5,670 filmmakers put their necks on the line for you to fight this merger. Another 75,000+ and counting have signed to tell you not to concede in just 3 weeks. You work for the people — the very people who will be hurt if you let this lousy deal filled with empty promises go forward. Please sign to send a message to the AGs and Paramount. Reject the deal. The people don’t want it!”
title_zh: 馬克·魯法洛(Mark Ruffalo)表示，派拉蒙(Paramount)與華納兄弟(Warner Bros.)的合併將會「抑制創意」並「削弱言論自由」：這「不應該被批准」。
content_zh:
由佩頓·圖克塔布(Payton Turkeltaub)報導

馬克·魯法洛(Mark Ruffalo)再次對派拉蒙(Paramount)與華納兄弟(Warner Bros.)的合併發表意見，這次是在週三得知該交易已獲批准並預計下週完成的消息後。

魯法洛在週三發佈於Threads的聲明中寫道：“這次合併將扼殺創造力，削弱言論自由，並使人們失去工作——這對這個國家來說是一個糟糕的交易，根本不應該獲得批准。這對我們數十萬站出來阻止它的人來說是個令人失望的結果，但這並不是結束。這場草根運動不會消失，我們的決心也不會。”

他接著說：“這從來不僅僅是關於一個合併：這是關於對抗腐敗的寡頭億萬富翁，踐踏普通人利益以填滿自己的口袋。我們仍在這場戰鬥中。加入我們。”

魯法洛長期以來一直公開反對這項合併。本月早些時候，魯法洛鼓勵加州檢察長羅伯·邦塔(Rob Bonta)及其11位其他州檢察長的聯盟不要和解對派拉蒙·天際線(Paramount Skydance)的訴訟，這將有效地阻止大衛·艾利森(David Ellison)收購華納兄弟探索(Warner Bros. Discovery)。

“你不要妥協，[羅伯·邦塔]，不要屈服，”魯法洛在X上寫道。“5,670位電影製作人為你冒著風險來對抗這次合併。又有超過75,000人簽名告訴你在短短3週內不要讓步。你是為人民工作——那些如果你讓這個充滿空洞承諾的糟糕交易繼續進行將受到傷害的人。請簽名向檢察長和派拉蒙發送信息。拒絕這筆交易。人民不想要它！”
